description: This file provides a comprehensive JWT authentication and authorization handler for a proxy server, supporting token parsing, validation against public keys, role and scope checks, user and team object retrieval, and integration with external OIDC and JWT configurations. It defines classes such as JWTHandler and JWTAuthManager to manage user roles, team memberships, and route/model access based on JWT claims and environment configurations.

classes.name: JWTHandler
classes.description: Handles JWT token parsing, validation (including key fetching and parsing), role and scope extraction, and OIDC user info retrieval.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JWTHandler with HTTP handling and leeway settings.

methods.name: update_environment
methods.description: Sets runtime environment parameters including Prisma client, cache, and JWT auth configurations.

methods.name: is_jwt
methods.description: Checks if a token string appears to be a JWT by splitting into three parts.

methods.name: _rbac_role_from_role_mapping
methods.description: Determines RBAC role based on role mappings in token.

methods.name: get_rbac_role
methods.description: Determines the overall RBAC role (admin, team, user, or none) for a token based on scopes and mappings.

methods.name: is_admin
methods.description: Checks if the token scopes include admin scope.

methods.name: get_team_ids_from_jwt
methods.description: Extracts team IDs from the token payload based on configured field.

methods.name: get_end_user_id
methods.description: Extracts end user ID from token claims.

methods.name: is_required_team_id
methods.description: Checks if team ID is mandated via configuration.

methods.name: is_enforced_email_domain
methods.description: Checks if email domain restrictions are enforced.

methods.name: get_team_id
methods.description: Retrieves the team ID from token claims or default.

methods.name: is_upsert_user_id
methods.description: Determines whether to upsert user ID based on config and email validation.

methods.name: get_user_id
methods.description: Retrieves user ID from token claims or default.

methods.name: get_user_roles
methods.description: Extracts user roles list from token claims.

methods.name: map_jwt_role_to_litellm_role
methods.description: Maps JWT roles to internal LiteLLM user roles.

methods.name: is_allowed_user_role
methods.description: Checks if user roles permit access based on allowed roles configuration.

methods.name: get_user_email
methods.description: Extracts user email from token claims.

methods.name: get_object_id
methods.description: Extracts object ID claim from token.

methods.name: get_org_id
methods.description: Extracts organization ID claim from token.

methods.name: get_scopes
methods.description: Parses the scope claim into a list of scope strings.

methods.name: get_public_key
methods.description: Fetches public keys from environment URL, with caching, matching by kid if provided.

methods.name: parse_keys
methods.description: Parses JWK keys list/dict, matching by kid if provided.

methods.name: is_allowed_domain
methods.description: Checks if user email's domain matches allowed domain.

methods.name: get_oidc_userinfo
methods.description: Fetches user info from OIDC UserInfo endpoint, optionally caching results.

methods.name: auth_jwt
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token using obtained public key, supporting multiple algorithms and handling expiry.

classes.name: JWTAuthManager
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage roles, route/model access, user/tenant retrieval, and validation logic for JWT-based authentication within the proxy context.

methods.name: can_rbac_role_call_route
methods.description: Checks if role is authorized for route.

methods.name: can_rbac_role_call_model
methods.description: Checks if role is authorized for model access.

methods.name: check_scope_based_access
methods.description: Enforces scope-based access control for requested models.

methods.name: check_rbac_role
methods.description: Validates role and model permissions during request.

methods.name: check_admin_access
methods.description: Verifies if token belongs to an admin and if route access is permitted.

methods.name: find_and_validate_specific_team_id
methods.description: Retrieves and validates a specific team ID from token claim.

methods.name: get_all_team_ids
methods.description: Aggregates all team IDs from token claims.

methods.name: find_team_with_model_access
methods.description: Finds the first team with access to a requested model, validating route permissions.

methods.name: get_user_info
methods.description: Extracts user email, ID, and domain validation status.

methods.name: get_objects
methods.description: Fetches user, org, end user, and team membership objects.

methods.name: validate_object_id
methods.description: Ensures valid RBAC IDs are present if enforcement is enabled.

methods.name: get_team_id_from_header
methods.description: Extracts team ID from HTTP headers with validation.

methods.name: map_user_to_teams
methods.description: Adds user to team if not already a member, via external endpoint.

methods.name: sync_user_role_and_teams
methods.description: Synchronizes user's roles and team memberships with token claims.

methods.name: auth_builder
methods.description: Main entry point for JWT auth flow: decodes/validates token, checks roles/scopes, retrieves objects, manages team membership, and returns role-based result.
